text: This Odnoklassniki landing sets its disable preference to true. The inspected core filters that preference from getProtocols, and the setup wizard builds choices from that list. Direct registered-protocol lookup remains available for existing accounts; the account module now reports a localized error and then disconnected instead of constructing an XMPP session. The fixed accepted code retains these scoped contracts. This establishes local behavior only; no remote gateway or live connection was tested.
title: Disabling a chat protocol hides setup choices while retaining a local failure path for existing accounts
